name: xcode-clean
title: Xcode Clean
description: Clean Xcode caches, DerivedData, Swift Package Manager, simulator caches, device support, and Kotlin Multiplatform Gradle builds.
author: edoardo.pavan

preferences.name: kotlinProjectsRoot
preferences.title: Kotlin Projects Root
preferences.description: The parent folder that contains ALL your projects, not a single project folder (e.g. ~/Projects, not ~/Projects/my_app). Used by the Clean Kotlin Multiplatform Project command to scan for Gradle/KMP modules.

preferences.name: confirmBeforeDelete
preferences.title: Safety
preferences.label: Confirm before deleting
preferences.description: Show a confirmation dialog before any deletion.

commands.name: clean-kmp
commands.title: Clean Kotlin Multiplatform Project
commands.description: In preferences, set the parent folder that contains all your projects (not a single project folder). This command scans it for every Gradle/KMP module and runs ./gradlew clean on the one you pick.

commands.name: clean-all-xcode
commands.title: Clean All Xcode Caches
commands.description: Clean DerivedData, Swift Package Manager, Module Cache, Xcode caches, and Simulator caches.

commands.name: clean-simulator-caches
commands.title: Clean Simulator Caches
commands.description: Clean CoreSimulator caches (does not delete simulators).

commands.name: clean-device-support
commands.title: Clean Device Support
commands.description: Clean iOS/watchOS/tvOS/macOS Device Support and Device Logs.

commands.name: clean-derived-data-project
commands.title: Clean Derived Data (Single Project)
commands.description: Pick a single project entry inside DerivedData and clean only that one.

commands.name: clean-gradle-global
commands.title: Clean Global Gradle Cache
commands.description: Delete ~/.gradle/caches. All Gradle projects will need to re-download dependencies.

commands.name: stop-gradle-daemons
commands.title: Stop Gradle / Kotlin Daemons
commands.description: Kill all running GradleDaemon and KotlinCompileDaemon processes.

commands.name: cache-overview
commands.title: Show Cache Sizes
commands.description: Overview of every cache with size and per-cache clean action.
